title: Jade + Steel

S must have flat top and bottom terminals and open negative space. Deliberate optical gaps and consistent stroke weights. The entire mark must read "SFT", not "ST", "SFI" or "SΓI". The material finish and illumination provide interest: deep jade satin enamel, dark graphite structural edges, restrained brushed steel surfaces, controlled warm highlight. Quiet pale-stone studio background, realistic tactile craftsmanship, secure and corporate rather than playful. Avoid monumental buildings or invented facilities.

Bottom: preserve the full nine-icon family STYLE from Precision Foundry (reference 2): substantial dark graphite rounded-square app tiles, fine steel bevels, tactile enamel/inlaid materials, serious professional pictograms, controlled product-specific accent colors. Preserve the warm pale stone studio background, subtle copper rim highlights, realistic brushed metal, gentle shadows, frontal camera with very slight depth, large centered logo. Single monogram only. No text captions, no board, no product icons, no circles, no shields, no tagline. Render a crisp landscape close-up with comfortable margin.
